_doc: Known, adjudicated CLI <-> models_explore (MCP) disagreements for scripts/snapshot_crosscheck.py. Hand-maintained, reviewed in PRs. Every entry names the model, field, kind, the date it was SEEN, and the exact observed detail: an allowlisted disagreement is still printed, fails again if its detail changes, and is reported stale once the sources agree. Add an entry only after deciding the snapshot is right (or the difference is representation); if the snapshot is wrong, re-dump models_explore instead. Catalog MEMBERSHIP entries (kind snapshot-only | cli-only) name the model, kind, type, seen date and a note saying why the model is in one source only; they go stale when the model stops being one-sided.
